note:
Quency: Escape Queen — SMG/Water. Board: 1.041 HOT on 2 graded comps (1.02 / 1.06). All 12 kit lines are modeled; the unmodeled arrays are empty by audit, not by omission. Magnitudes, durations and stack caps are datamined-exact, and kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/quency-escape-queen.test.ts.
KIT MACHINE. S2 (hitCount 2 = every pull, since hitsPerShot is 2) builds the Explore Route on ONE self block carrying all six stacks: stage 1 (ATK 2.45 x10 / 2s + Hit Rate 1.36 x10 / 2s), stage 2 (ATK 4.9 x10 / 1s + HR 2.71 x10 / 1s), stage 3 (ATK 7.36 x5 / 0.5s + HR 4.08 x5 / 0.5s). One block is the right shape because the kit says 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' — at stage 3 every activation applies all stages. Peak while firing: ATK +110.3%, Hit Rate +61.1%. Stack uptime is self-simulated rather than scripted: stage 1 (2s) survives the 1.35s reload, stage 2 (1s) and stage 3 (0.5s) lapse each reload and rebuild on resume (buff refresh = re-apply per pull; distinct values are distinct co-stacking keys).
S1 is three Explore-Route-max-GATED self permanents, encoded as firing-tracking proxies rather than blind passives. S1a Distributed Damage 49.58 at stage-1 max → a passive: the 2s stack window outlasts the reload, so it is effectively permanent, and its only consumer is the burst's distributed nuke, which first fires ~5.4s — far later than the ~1s stage-1 build — so the frame-0 apply has zero observable effect on any damage instance. S1b core damage 25.25 at stage-2 max → hitCount 20 (= 10 pulls, the 10-stack rebuild), 1s. S1c crit 16.73 at stage-3 max → hitCount 10 (= 5 pulls), 0.5s. Both mirror the real gate — continuous while firing, lapsing ~1s into the reload, rebuilding in ~0.42s.
BURST: self attackDamagePct 57.08 + reloadSpeedPct 25.87 (10s; reload speed is a shot-count lever for her), and a 1736.31% distributed nuke on the boss. Burst-cast damage is auto-FB-exempt, and S1a's +49.58 distributed bucket applies to it at cast.
CADENCE: EFFECTIVE 20 pulls/s. rate_of_fire 1440rpm = 2.5 frames, which the engine's default-on SMG frame quantization rounds to 3 frames = 20.0/s (ammo-counter MEASURED; 24/s is the un-quantized SMGRATE=24 revert arm only). muzzle_count 2 gives 40 bullets/s, but the shot damage SPLITS across the two bullets (normalAttackMultiplier 10.12 = 5.06 per bullet x 2 muzzles, already baked in), so 20 shots x 10.12 is self-consistent and NOT over-modeled. The proxy arithmetic holds at 20/s: hitCount 2 → ~20 applies/s; hitCount 20 → one apply per 0.5s against a 1s core-damage window; hitCount 10 → one per 0.25s against a 0.5s crit window. Every tier saturates and lapses only across reloads, so the encoding is cadence-robust. reloadFrames 81 is raw datamine ⚑; reload_start_ammo 119 is a near-full rolling start ⚑.
⚑ OPEN — STAGE-UNLOCK ORDERING is not encoded. Stages 2 and 3 build in PARALLEL with stage 1 instead of unlocking after it, which over-credits them by ~0.4-0.8s per ramp and per post-reload rebuild — roughly 0.5-1% of fight total. This is the leading candidate for her HOT read, and it is an ENGINE-PRIMITIVE gap (it needs a stack-count gate / cascade-order primitive), not an override tuning question. Do not shave her datamined magnitudes to close it.
⚑ OPEN — 'after 2 normal attacks' is hits-vs-pulls ambiguous. count 2 reads it as 2 hits = one pull; if it means 2 SHOTS the count is 4. Steady-state insensitive, ramp-only.
⚑ OPEN — the HR → core-rate conversion slope is engine-global and measured-only; the kit's hitRatePct magnitudes themselves are datamined-true.
caveats: skill1: the three Explore-Route-max gates are firing-tracking proxies (a passive, and two hitCount thresholds), not a real stack-count gate — rebuild timing after reloads is approximate, and the hit counter carries over reloads, so the rebuild is slightly optimistic (⚑)

skill2: stage-2 and stage-3 stacks build in PARALLEL with stage 1 because the kit's stage-unlock ordering has no engine primitive — a ~0.4-0.8s over-credit per ramp and per post-reload rebuild, ~0.5-1% of fight total. This is the leading candidate for her 1.041 HOT read; it is an engine-primitive gap, not a magnitude to shave (⚑)
skill2: Hit Rate stacks are modeled as hitRatePct — LIVE via CONE_DELTA, feeding her SMG core rate through acrForHR; the in-game magnitude of the core-rate lift is unmeasured (⚑)

all: cadence = EFFECTIVE 20 pulls/s (SMG frame quantization is default-on: rate_of_fire 1440rpm = 2.5 frames → ceil 3 → 20.0/s, ammo-counter MEASURED; 24/s is the un-quantized SMGRATE=24 revert arm only). muzzle_count 2 gives 40 bullets/s, but shot damage SPLITS over the 2 bullets (nAM 10.12 = 5.06 x 2, already baked in), so throughput of 20 shots x 10.12 is self-consistent, not over-modeled (owner-confirmed). reloadFrames 81 is still raw datamine (⚑)

burst: the 1736.31% distributed nuke carries no explicit crit field, so it inherits the engine's crit-ON default for function damage (crit at the caster rate); damage-calculation §1 marks distributed-damage crit as DISPUTED. Resolution is engine-global — settle it once for all distributed carriers: on a focus recording of her burst, read the nuke popup colour/icon across several casts (orange + icon = crit-eligible, white-only across many casts = crit-exempt); a crit/non-crit popup PAIR at x1.5 settles it outright.

burst: the 1736.31% distributed nuke carries burstDesc:'allEnemies' — its kit line sits under '■ Affects all enemies.', the exact string trina's Spread Roots names, so she is a TRUE carrier under the literal-only ruling (owner 2026-08-10). It reads the trina-family burstSkillAoeDamagePct amp when cast inside an amp window; no amp shares her comps today, so the tag is board-inert (full A/B diff byte-identical). The distributed flavor is orthogonal — the amp lands in Damage Up, the distributed split in its own bucket. ⚑ the amp's additive Damage-Up placement is unmeasured.
